retention.note: RPO/RTO and the rest of the lifecycle values are unconfirmed pilot policy decisions; they stay UNVERIFIED and fail closed (auto cleanup can never be enabled on top of them).

rollbackRetention.note: After a restore, old evidence can never authorize a new SHA; rollback targets the same digest and keeps the last approved artifact; a credential rotation or revocation forces re-verification because a backup cannot restore revoked capabilities.
